content: {"praised":["Strong performances by Bette Midler and Nathan Lane.","Accurate portrayal of Jacqueline Susann’s life and Valley of the Dolls.","Vibrant, colorful 60s-70s costumes and settings.","Engaging, dramatic storyline about Susann’s rise to fame.","Memorable musical score by Burt Bacharach."],"criticized":["Film’s story feels vague and poorly developed.","Casting decisions ruined the film’s potential.","Acting was thin, Midler’s performance felt like a parody.","Pacing was slow and disappointing.","Overall quality was deplorable and disappointing."]}
